findings.one_line: The promised sharp all-(n,k) coordinate-degree frontier is not delivered: this node leaves the entire positive-excess below-threshold strip open and replaces the requested recurrence/attaining families with an envelope and threshold result.

The promised graph-input algorithm returning exact d_e and its minimal polynomial with certificates is still open; the current operational output is only an algebraicity tag and ceiling, while exact polynomial output requires a supplied source-prime chart.
